headline: Executive order sets the line of officials who would temporarily lead the Department of Agriculture if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order sets an order of succession within the U.S. Department of Agriculture. Orders like this name which officials would act as Secretary of Agriculture, and in what order, if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific officials and details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Agriculture
who_it_affects.how: Some of them may be named to temporarily perform the Secretary's duties if top leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; no separate start date is given in the available information.
